turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Hello there! How's your day treating you?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: I'm great, thanks.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: I run a little bakery and I need music for the shop. What works?

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Something warm and relaxed that doesn't distract. Acoustic, soft soul or gentle jazz all work well in cafes and bakeries.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: They're definitely going to ask my salary expectations tomorrow and I freeze every time.

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Let's plan it. Would you rather name a range you've researched, or turn it back and ask what budget they have for the role?

turns.speaker: friend
turns.text: Hey, can I borrow you for a minute?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Ugh, okay. Moshi, quiet for a minute.

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Sure thing.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Are you back on the night shift this week?

turns.speaker: friend
turns.text: Unfortunately, starting tomorrow.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Rosa, if we shared a personal trainer, would you actually show up?

turns.speaker: friend
turns.text: Rude. I show up to things.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: You cancelled yoga three times last month.

turns.speaker: friend
turns.text: Yoga was at seven in the morning. That's not fair.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Okay, so evenings. Would you do Tuesdays and Thursdays?

turns.speaker: friend
turns.text: Thursdays, yes. Tuesdays I have choir.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Then I'll ask if he does Thursdays and maybe a Sunday morning.

turns.speaker: friend
turns.text: Not too early on Sunday. Ten at the earliest.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Okay, I'm back.

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Sure thing. The salary question. Are you naming a range or asking for their budget?
